geometry: A 158 by 32 translucent rectangular shadow, with a dark blue-gray to near-black vertical gradient and soft fades on all four edges. Center alpha peaks at 179/255; edge fades span roughly 6 pixels.
limitations: Smooth gradient approximates the source's subtle color variation and corner falloff; the enlarged SVG rendering was visually inspected.
qt5_compatibility: Rewritten without <mask>, <clipPath> or <filter>, which Qt5's SVG renderer ignores: masked gradient products became 1px strips, clips became hard-stop gradients or even-odd paths, and blur became stacked translucent shapes.
